svg.title: Shovel rewards: gold shovel, then random helmet
svg.desc: The Golden Shovel is personal thirty-dig progress; the Golden Helmet is a later random ordinary-dig reward, not a perk-bottle requirement.

g.text: Shovel rewards: gold shovel, then random helmet
BO2 Origins · Original reference diagram · not a gameplay screenshot
Search the spawn racks first; other racks are in tunnels and lower Church.
Dig ordinary piles and confirm your shovel’s gold HUD icon.
A later ordinary dig can award the helmet. Check its separate icon.
ROBOT ENTRY · THE LIT HATCH STILL MATTERS
The helmet protects against a stomp; shoot the foot hatch to enter.
Golden Shovel is required for red-mound bottles. Golden Helmet is optional.
Dead Drop · Read the accompanying steps for the complete route.
